title: What Happens When 3 Dumb Shoplifters Steal 15 Boxes Of Perfume
description:
On June 4th, 2024. 3 dumb shoplifters fled from a store in which they just stole 15 boxes of perfume from. Officers chased them until they crashed into a utility pool after they hit the side of a mans car. The 3 shoplifters claimed they did not know each other and they did it to feed their families.
